prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Miami after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
Here are 5 Miami-area personal injury firms I recommend you call — and why each one is worth contacting. (If your injuries are catastrophic or you have wrongful death exposure, say that when you call so they prioritize the intake.)

1) Podhurst Orseck LLP (Miami)
- Why: Long-standing Miami plaintiff firm with a strong record handling catastrophic car-accident cases, wrongful death, and complex litigation. Known for trial experience and large-case resources.
- Best to call if you have severe injuries, permanent impairment, or a potential high-value claim.

2) Colson Hicks Eidson
- Why: Miami-based plaintiff firm that handles serious personal injury and medical malpractice matters with experience taking cases to verdict. Good reputation for complex injury litigation.
- Best to call if your case involves significant medical bills, long-term care, or disputed liability.

3) Kanner & Pintaluga
- Why: Local Miami plaintiff firm focusing on auto collisions and catastrophic injuries. Smaller/boutique firms like this often provide hands-on attention from senior attorneys.
- Best to call if you want a local team that will be directly involved and accessible.

4) Morgan & Morgan (Miami office)
- Why: National plaintiff firm with large resources, many car-accident cases, and nationwide medical/rehab referral networks. They advertise widely and handle high volumes of vehicle-accident claims.
- Best to call if you want a firm that can advance costs, has a lot of staff to manage paperwork, and can handle complex lien issues.

5) Shamis & Gentile (South Florida)
- Why: Regional plaintiff firm that handles auto crashes and personal injury with experience in settlements and litigation across South Florida. Often multilingual and familiar with local courts.
- Best to call if you want experienced local representation with a practical approach to settlement or trial.

How to choose which to call first
- If your injuries are catastrophic or there’s a wrongful-death element: prioritize Podhurst Orseck or Colson Hicks Eidson.
- If you want large-firm resources to advance costs and handle complex lien/insurance issues: add Morgan & Morgan.
- If you want more hands-on local attention: call Kanner & Pintaluga and Shamis & Gentile.

What to ask when you call (quick script)
- Do you handle car-accident/personal-injury cases? Do you offer a free consultation?
- Have you handled cases like mine (describe injuries, crash facts)? Any recent settlements/verdicts you can share?
- Who will handle the file — partner or junior attorney? Will I meet the attorney handling my case?
- What is your contingency fee percentage? Do you advance litigation/medical-record costs?
- How do you handle medical liens/insurance subrogation?
- How long do you expect the case to take and what are realistic outcomes?
- Are you fluent in [Spanish/Portuguese] (if you need that)?

Immediate next steps for best results
- Seek/continue medical care and keep records.
- Get a copy of the police report.
- Take/keep photos of the scene, damage, injuries, and any visible marks.
- Preserve evidence (car parts, clothing) and get contact info for witnesses.
- Do not give a recorded statement to the other driver’s insurer or sign any release without talking to a lawyer.

Verify before hiring
- Check each attorney’s disciplinary status on the Florida Bar website.
- Read recent client reviews (Google, Avvo, Martindale-Hubbell).
- Ask the firm for a written retainer that clearly explains fees and costs.

If you want, tell me:
- the zip code of the crash, brief injury summary, and whether it’s a truck, multi-car, DUI, or hit-and-run — I can then prioritize which firms from the list are the best first calls for your exact situation and draft a 30–60 second intake script you can use on the phone.
